name: CSAT
summary: The shared thumbs up/down satisfaction prompt — the one CSAT control, not a bespoke rating.
highlights: Shared thumbs up and down satisfaction prompt
The one CSAT control, not a bespoke rating
lead: ONE custom element — <aha-csat> — the reusable form of the feedback pattern's CSAT rule. A binary thumbs-up/down prompt with a required `source` for typo-proof analytics segmentation; it emits a composed `rate` event, and once rated only the chosen thumb remains (clicking it again un-rates), and a thumbs-down opens a free-text feedback popover that emits a composed `feedback` event on submit. Shadow-DOM CSS, themed only by --aha-* tokens; the thumbs are the shared <aha-icon> BY NAME, the follow-up reuses the shared <aha-popover> + <aha-counted-textarea> + <aha-button>, and the selected/hover states animate on PERSISTENT button nodes (class toggle, no rebuild). Zero drift.
codeNote: Same element, same shadow-DOM CSS → identical render. React (< 19) consumes it via a thin wrapper that listens for the `rate` and `feedback` events; Vue binds the custom element natively. Defined once in @ahaslides-product/design.

spec.label: Layout
spec.value: borderless single row (28px high): 12px #616161 prompt, 4px gap, then 28×28 borderless thumb buttons with 16px #4A4A4A icons, 2px apart (--aha-space-2); opt-in `layout="stacked"` puts the prompt on the top line and the buttons on the line below, both left-aligned (2px between the lines)

spec.label: Hover
spec.value: ghost fill #E70E680D · icon #1A1A1A text-default (motion tokens) · tooltip Good / Not good / Feedback (above by default, below with `tooltip-placement="bottom"`)

spec.label: Selected
spec.value: the presenter's antd tertiary active state — fill #E70E680D (bg-accent) · icon #DB005B (text-link-hover, the Button's Tertiary active ink, 4.66:1 on white) with or without `confirmation` · aria-pressed synced; hover keeps the selected look

spec.label: Rating toggle
spec.value: once rated both thumbs stay visible and the chosen one shows the active state; clicking the other thumb switches the rating (`rate` fires with the new value); clicking the chosen thumb again un-rates — `value` is removed and `rate` fires with rating null

spec.label: Thumbs-up
spec.value: rates instantly — reflects value='up', keeps the thumbs-down visible, emits `rate`

spec.label: Thumbs-down
spec.value: registers value='down' + emits `rate`, keeps the thumbs-up visible, then opens a feedback popover (shared <aha-popover>, role=dialog · Esc/outside-click close) anchored to the thumbs group and always fully visible (end-aligned by default, start-aligned with `feedback-placement="start"`; it flips above the thumbs when the CSAT sits at the bottom of the viewport, stays inside the side edges, and renders in the browser top layer, so no overflow, transform or contain:paint ancestor clips it and no sidebar or toast covers it) — a 20px X whose hover is a rounded square (6px radius) (closes only, never submits, keeps the down rating), an <aha-counted-textarea> (2000 characters, placeholder How can we improve? Let us know!, focused on open) and a secondary Send button that stays disabled until text is typed; after Send it closes and does not re-open on thumbs-down until the rating changes again; the heading is optional (`feedback-prompt`, none by default)

spec.label: Feedback button
spec.value: opt-in `feedback-button` — a chat icon immediately right of the thumbs (tooltip Feedback), visible whether or not rated, that opens the same popover without changing the rating; submitting clears the field so feedback can be sent again

spec.label: Feedback after a like
spec.value: opt-in `feedback-on="any"` (default `down`) — a thumbs-up also opens the same feedback popover (same once-per-rating rule, closable with no text, `feedback` carries rating 'up'); the up thumb then carries aria-haspopup=dialog · aria-expanded. Unset, only thumbs-down opens it

spec.label: Received state
spec.value: opt-in `confirmation="<text>"` — once rated, and again after a feedback Send, the text shows inline after the thumbs (under them with `layout="stacked"`) in a 12px #616161 role=status live region (re-announced after Send); the received text is all it adds; the chosen thumb looks the same with or without it. Unset, nothing is added

spec.label: Feedback hint
spec.value: opt-in `feedback-hint="<text>"` — a helper line under the feedback text box, beside the character counter (the shared <aha-counted-textarea> info-message), for example to say who reads the feedback; an error message on the field replaces it while it shows. Unset, no hint

spec.label: Events
spec.value: `rate` → { rating: 'up' | 'down' | null, source } (null when un-rated) · `feedback` → { rating: 'up' | 'down' | null, source, feedback } (null when unrated — the Feedback button needs no rating)

props.name: prompt
props.desc: Optional question shown before the thumbs

props.name: source
props.desc: Stable placement token for analytics — passed in the rate and feedback events

props.name: value
props.desc: The current rating (also reflects a click, removed on un-rate); both thumbs stay visible while set, and the selected thumb's aria-pressed syncs

props.name: feedback-prompt
props.desc: Optional heading in the feedback popover, beside the X — none by default

props.name: feedback-button
props.desc: Show the Feedback chat-icon button after the thumbs; it opens the feedback popover without rating

props.name: feedback-button-placeholder
props.desc: Placeholder when the popover is opened from the Feedback button (falls back to feedback-placeholder)

props.name: tooltip-placement
props.desc: Where the Good / Not good / Feedback tooltips open; use bottom inside a card whose title sits above the CSAT so the tooltips do not cover it. Any other value falls back to top; the feedback popover placement is set by feedback-placement

props.name: feedback-placement
props.desc: Which edge of the thumbs the feedback popover aligns to: end opens it with its right edge on the thumbs (extends to the left), start with its left edge on the thumbs (extends to the right — use it when the CSAT sits in the left corner of a narrow panel). It still flips above at the bottom of the viewport. Any other value falls back to end

props.name: layout
props.desc: row keeps the prompt and buttons on one line; stacked puts the prompt on the top line and the buttons on the line below, both left-aligned. Any other value falls back to row

props.name: feedback-on
props.desc: down opens the feedback popover only after a thumbs-down; any also opens it after a thumbs-up (once per rating, closable with no text; the feedback event carries rating up). Any other value falls back to down

props.name: confirmation
props.desc: Opt-in received text, for example Thanks, feedback received: shown inline beside the thumbs (under them with layout stacked) once rated and again after a feedback Send, in a role=status live region; the chosen thumb's look does not depend on it. Not set, no text

props.name: feedback-hint
props.desc: Opt-in helper line under the feedback text box, for example What you write goes to the developer. Not set, no hint. Changing or removing it updates the open popover

props.name: like-label
props.desc: Tooltip and accessible name of the thumbs-up

props.name: dislike-label
props.desc: Tooltip and accessible name of the thumbs-down

props.name: feedback-placeholder
props.default: How can we improve? Let us know!
props.desc: Placeholder for the free-text field in the feedback popover

whenToUse.when: a lightweight satisfaction check on a feature or a piece of content
a full-block outcome after an operation
you need structured, multi-field feedback with validation

opinion.note: Use the shared control — never build a bespoke rating. Always pass a stable `source` per placement so segmentation stays typo-proof. Keep it to the binary thumbs (plus the optional Feedback button); show the “Thank you for your feedback!” toast from the `feedback` event with the shared toast hook; free-text is asked for ONLY after a thumbs-down (the built-in feedback popover), and never block rendering on tracking.
opinion.dsv3: COVERED — this is the reusable component form of the feedback pattern's CSAT rule (parts/feedback.guide.md): a binary thumbs widget with a required source token, and the 'ask for free-text only after a thumbs-down' follow-up realised by reusing <aha-popover> + <aha-counted-textarea> + <aha-button>. The dedicated `feedback` event maps to the pattern's distinct CSAT_FEEDBACK_SUBMITTED analytics event (separate from CSAT_RATED). Colours + motion map to the token layer. A deliberate, documented AhaSlides surface.

conformance.$about: Measured by qa.mjs against the RENDERED UI (getComputedStyle via headless CDP). Leaf = ONE shared element, single render. The [data-probe] probe is pre-rated (value='up') so the borderless single-row layout — the muted #616161 400-weight 12px prompt, the borderless 28×28 thumb button, the selected primary colour and the aria-pressed a11y contract — is measurable; it also pins the thumbs-down feedback flow: the down thumb carries aria-haspopup='dialog' and the shared <aha-popover> is present in the shadow root.
